package ui

// The stand-in for video_review_hooks_test.go on the round-3 head
// (0cbe7e63), which has neither: its players' FrameReady is a.animReady
// (video.go), which calls the huddle controller's ImagesChanged whenever
// one is live (quiet.go). This counts those calls as it makes them. Its
// slider opened the moment the pointer reached the volume control, and
// State had no VolumeOpen: the hovered controls' slider stands in.

import (
	"image"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/some-du6e/clack/internal/ui/videoplayer"
)

var redHudPings int64

func playerFrameReady(e *perfEnv) func() {
	return func() {
		if e.a.hudLive.Load() != nil {
			redHudPings++
		}
		e.a.animReady()
	}
}

func hudPings(e *perfEnv) int64 { return redHudPings }

func volumeOpen(st videoplayer.State) bool { return st.Hover && !st.Slider.Empty() }

// no idle release there
func keepIdlePlayers(*testing.T) {}

// no mini player there (video_pip_hooks_test.go's)
type pipView struct {
	rect     image.Rectangle
	controls []image.Rectangle
	corner   string
	playing  bool
	elapsed  time.Duration
	trigger  string
}

func pipShown(*perfEnv) (pipView, bool) { return pipView{}, false }
